text: Chemistry is a fundamental discipline that studies the composition, structure, properties, transformation laws and applications of substances. It is hailed as the "central science" and deeply intersects with physics, biology, materials science, environment and other disciplines. The Chemistry major aims to cultivate talents with a solid theoretical foundation in chemistry, experimental skills and scientific research thinking. It focuses on understanding the material world from the molecular/atomic level and solving practical problems in fields such as energy, materials, medicine and the environment. Depending on the research focus, chemistry can be divided into branches such as inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, and polymer chemistry, and at the same time, it has derived interdisciplinary directions such as materials chemistry, biochemistry, and computational chemistry.
